title: Terms of service
intro: These terms describe how purchases on the MECHWARE website work. They are a plain-language draft.

p: MECHWARE sells directly, from its own stock and from the stock of authorised distributors. Legal entity name, trade licence and registration details: [to be confirmed]. BIN: [to be confirmed].

VAT is set per product category (5% by default unless set otherwise: [to be confirmed]). Guests see prices including VAT. Signed-in company accounts see prices without VAT and the VAT as a separate line.
Our server calculates the final price, VAT and delivery fee. They are shown before you pay.
An online payment is accepted as paid only after our server has verified it with the payment provider, not when your browser returns to our site.
An order waiting for online payment is cancelled automatically after 30 minutes.
